messages:
mia: FYI — after the 03:10 deploy the rbac-gateway started returning 403s for a subset of requests hitting /v1/metadata. Noticed an uptick in errors from dedicated customers.
raj: Seeing it in logs too. Error pattern is 'permission_denied: missing resource: proxy.token.read' for some service accounts.
devon: Is this only new tokens or older ones too?
mia: Mostly tokens minted in the last 24h, but not all. Could be a role mapping change.
olivia: I rolled the RBAC policy PR earlier this morning (reverted two rules) — could be that. PR = github.com/redwood/rbac/changeset/488.
samir: Can you paste the exact rule that changed?
mia: Snippet from the policy we deployed:
```
- allow: proxy.token.read
  resources: ["service_account/*"]
  principals: ["role:svc-proxy"]
- deny: proxy.token.read
  resources: ["service_account/{workspace}:*"]
  principals: ["role:temp-tokens"]
```
mia: The deny was intended to be scoped to temp-tokens but the glob matched the svc-proxy role in some workspaces.
raj: Ah, sandbox vs prod naming collision. The pattern `{workspace}:*` didn't behave as expected with the proxy's composite principal.
devon: Quick mitigation idea: add a fallback rule granting proxy.token.read to role:svc-proxy with a higher priority so existing tokens aren't blocked.
olivia: On it. I'll open a hotfix PR to add an explicit allow with priority 1000.
samir: We should also update the SDKs to expose better error hints for permission_denied + resource. Right now the client just surfaces 403.
mia: Agree — add a small error payload keys: denied_resource and required_permission. That will help app teams route retries/fallbacks.
security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1186. Assigned to eng-security + eng-platform.
raj: For immediate troubleshooting, I pushed a temp rule to policy store that scopes the deny to exact pattern `service_account/temp-*` instead of the workspace glob. Monitoring now.
devon: Metrics look better — 403s dropped ~88% in the last 3m.
mia: Thank you. Next steps: 1) olivia to merge hotfix (policy revert + explicit allow) 2) samir + devex to draft SDK error payload change 3) olivia to add a regression test for glob matching in policy engine 4) raj to run a one-off audit log export for last 72h for affected service accounts.
olivia: Will do. ETA for hotfix merge ~ 10m. Adding test now.
samir: I'll draft the SDK change as an opt-in error wrapper so we can ship quickly without breaking existing clients.
raj: One more thing — can we add an observability check for 'deny rule overlap' in CI so PRs that add denies with broad globs are flagged?
mia: Yes, rule overlap linting should be added to the policy repo. Add as an action item.
security-bot: Note: audit log entries for these denies are available in GCS bucket s3://redwood-audit/rbac/2026/03/14/.
devon: After hotfix merge + a couple of deploys, let's schedule a short postmortem doc in #postmortems. Keep it light — root cause = glob-based deny with unintended precedence.
olivia: Hotfix merged. Rolling deploy now.
raj: Deploy stable. 403s back to baseline. Closing INC-2026-1186 after postmortem.
mia: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short internal FAQ for platform customers explaining the allowed workspaces patterns and the SDK change timeline. :thumbsup:
